$comment: Status drawn: Qwen draws his new clips from a model sheet and words. The rig below stays for the pilot poses, and gives no OpenPose, since his body isn't human. His dance atlas stays as it is. No family spec yet: finish and pack wait until a palette and a reviewed wave exist.

drawing.look: big rounded rectangular ivory head, dark teal face screen with two cyan smiling arcs, one small cyan antenna ball on a thin stem, round ivory body with a cyan chest light, teal ball joints, short limbs, cyan cuff bands on the forearm of one arm only, thick dark outline
drawing.extra: Exactly two arms and two legs.
